title: CPCSC Level 1 malicious code protection needs deployed coverage and response evidence
remediation: The sponsor endpoint protection owner inventories assessed entry and exit points. Verify configured protection and update cadence, scheduled system scans, real-time scanning for external files, and mitigation behavior. Use a harmless approved test artifact to record an observed block, quarantine or approved alternate protection with its dated response record. The sponsor separately confirms applicability to the CPCSC Level 1 contract and certification boundary. An ITSP.10.171 reference or evidence mapped for a different assessed system establishes no disposition for this contract.

milestones.title: For CPCSC Level 1, collect assessed protection coverage, effective update and scan settings and a safe detection and mitigation exercise record
